retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s cassette J-card layout featuring a central monochrome portrait framed by bold red blocks and a mix of script and geometric typography.
triggerTerms: dramatic noir portrait with red borders

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition divided into three distinct zones: a top header with branding, a central high-contrast black and white photograph of a figure on a staircase, and a large bottom red block containing tracklist information. The color palette is strictly limited to vibrant red, black, and white.
coreVisualRelationships: Red borders framing a central monochrome image
Script-style artist name overlapping the top of the photo
Wide-tracked serif subtitle on a black bar
Centered sans-serif tracklist on a solid red field
coreInvariants: Vibrant primary red background for text blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure leaning on a banister, positioned centrally within the middle third of the vertical layout.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central monochrome photograph serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting with the logo, moving through the portrait, following the diagonal of the banister, and ending at the bottom tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid red blocks at the top and bottom provide significant breathing room for text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red paired with high-contrast grayscale imagery.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of casual script, wide-tracked serif, and bold geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Artist name uses a fluid, slanted script with connected letters.
Subtitles use a high-contrast serif with extreme letter spacing.
Tracklists use a clean, medium-weight geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'B' and 'M' are oversized and expressive.
Serif 'E' and 'T' have sharp, traditional terminals.

composition.position: bottom of image on black bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic pairing: expressive script for personality, wide serif for cinematic feel, and sans-serif for information density.

preserve: Wide tracking on the serif text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, casual feel of the artist name.
Matches the traditional serif look of the subtitle.
Provides the geometric sans-serif look for the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical layout with a large central black and white photograph of a man in a leather jacket leaning on an ornate stone staircase. Frame this image with solid vibrant red blocks at the top and bottom. Include a thin black horizontal bar at the bottom edge of the photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a white script font at the top left of the photo. Place the album title in a wide-tracked white serif font on the black bar. Center the tracklist in a bold black sans-serif font on the bottom red block.

verificationChecks: Is the photo high-contrast black and white?
Is the red background vibrant and solid?
Is the subtitle text extremely wide-tracked?
Does the script text overlap the top of the image?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the serif subtitle

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between red and monochrome elements

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast B&W photo quality
Ensure wide tracking on serif text
Confirm script font is legible against the photo background
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Layout [Red Header/Footer] + [B&W High-Contrast Photo] + [Script/Serif/Sans-Serif Typographic Mix]
